title: 2-Hydroxy-1-naphthaldehyde-based organotin(IV) complexes: structural aspects, cytotoxicity, DNA binding interaction, and molecular docking.
authors: Galvan-Hidalgo, Jose Miguel; Ambrocio-Perez, Donovan; Gonzalez-Hernandez, Arturo; Rodriguez-Hernandez, Karla Daniela; Ramirez-Apan, Teresa; Gomez-Garcia, Omar; Dorazco-Gonzalez, Alejandro; Villa-Rivera, Jorge J; Gomez-Velasco, Homero; Hernandez-Ortega, Simon; Gomez, Elizabeth
journal: Biometals : an international journal on the role of metal ions in biology, biochemistry, and medicine
one_liner_zh: 该文研究有机锡配合物的DNA结合与细胞毒性，虽含DNA结合实验和分子对接，但对象为小分子-核酸互作而非蛋白质-DNA体系，方法上仅常规对接，缺乏TF-DNA结合建模与AI/物理模拟深度，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: A series of organotin(IV) complexes (2a-2d) derived from 2-hydroxy-1-naphthaldehyde and pyridoxamine were obtained in good yields via a one-pot strategy. (119)Sn NMR confirmed hexacoordinated species in solution, and single-crystal X-ray diffraction of 2d revealed a distorted trigonal-bipyramidal geometry (tau = 0.65) with a C(2)NO(2) donor set. UV-Vis and fluorescence titrations with CT-DNA demonstrated intercalative binding (K(b) = 7.66-11.0 x 10(4) M(-1)), and isothermal titration calorimetry confirmed spontaneous, exothermic binding to ssDNA, with complex 2c showing stronger affinity than 2b due to combined enthalpic and entropic contributions. All complexes exhibited significantly higher cytotoxicity than cisplatin against MCF-7 and MDA-MB-231 breast cancer cell lines; 2c and 2d were the most potent (IC(50) = 0.06-0.26 muM), with 2d showing the best selectivity index (SI = 2.33 for MCF-7). Flow cytometry revealed cell-line-dependent mechanisms: MDA-MB-231 cells underwent cytostatic mitotic blockade, with suppression of S and G2/M phases, whereas MCF-7 cells exhibited features of apoptosis and G1 accumulation. Molecular docking against CDK2/cyclin A showed binding energies of -9.31 to -10.27 kcal/mol, substantially higher than cisplatin (- 4.09 kcal/mol), with 2d displaying the strongest affinity, consistent with its higher biological activity.
abstract_zh: 通过一锅法策略，以2-羟基-1-萘甲醛和吡哆胺为原料，高产率合成了一系列有机锡(IV)配合物（2a-2d）。(119)Sn NMR证实溶液中存在六配位物种，2d的单晶X射线衍射揭示其具有畸变的三角双锥几何构型（tau = 0.65），配位原子组成为C(2)NO(2)。UV-Vis和荧光滴定实验表明其与CT-DNA发生嵌入结合（K(b) = 7.66-11.0 x 10(4) M(-1)），等温滴定量热法确认了与ssDNA的自发放热结合，其中配合物2c因焓和熵贡献的协同作用，对ssDNA的亲和力强于2b。所有配合物对MCF-7和MDA-MB-231乳腺癌细胞系的细胞毒性均显著高于顺铂；2c和2d活性最强（IC(50) = 0.06-0.26 muM），其中2d表现出最佳选择性指数（MCF-7的SI = 2.33）。流式细胞术揭示了细胞系依赖性机制：MDA-MB-231细胞发生细胞静止性有丝分裂阻滞，S和G2/M期受到抑制，而MCF-7细胞则表现出凋亡特征和G1期积累。针对CDK2/cyclin A的分子对接显示结合能为-9.31至-10.27 kcal/mol，远高于顺铂（-4.09 kcal/mol），其中2d亲和力最强，与其较高的生物活性一致。
